Fixtures generated by real tools on 2026-11-07, not written by hand.

- `forge/`: Foundry forge 1.5.1-stable (b0a9dd9c), `forge build --build-info` over `forge/src/`
  (solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, evm cancun). The build-info is copied to `forge/build-info/`
  because `out/` is git-ignored.
  - `standard-json-input.json` is `forge verify-contract --show-standard-json-input <addr> src/Greeter.sol:Greeter`.
  - `minimal-build-info.json` is what a plain `forge build` (no `--build-info`) writes.
  - `forge-1.5.1-custom-verifier-requests.jsonl` holds the two requests
    `forge verify-contract --verifier custom --watch --constructor-args 0x…07` sent to a local
    recording server.
- `hardhat/`: Hardhat 2.29.1, `npx hardhat compile` over the same three sources under `contracts/`.
  - `hardhat-verify-2.1.3-requests.jsonl` holds the requests `npx hardhat verify --network citrate
    <addr> 7 hello` (hardhat-verify 2.1.3, per-network apiKey `citrate`, customChains 40204) sent
    to a local recording server, against a Greeter deployed on a local anvil.
